imgDesc.text:
When
Cryo comes in contact with
Electro, a special
Stellar-Conduct reaction will be triggered if certain conditions are also met. When this happens, a Starlight Prism is generated, and the surrounding area turns into a wondrous Polestar Field for a short period of time.
All characters inside the Polestar Field receive a Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus, and when opponents within the field are hit by Cryo or Electro attacks, the field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 4s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 4s.
Additionally, opponents within the Polestar Field will also have their Physical RES lowered.

Certain characters will also gain the effects of
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct when within the Polestar Field, enhancing certain Talents and skill effects.
Certain characters can deal Stellar-Conduct DMG to opponents using their Talents, and this DMG can trigger CRIT Hits.
